function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT period, c.channel, SUM(sl.qty) AS total_qty, SUM(sl.revenue_cad) AS revenue_cad
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.sales_line sl
JOIN lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.customer c ON sl.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE sl.period IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
GROUP BY period, c.channel
ORDER BY period, c.channel","purpose":"Check channel mix shift between Aug and Sep 2026"}
